sentences.text: Mr.Sankalp Kochar, learned counsel for the applicant.
Heard on I.A.No.8964/2016, an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

The applicant has filed this criminal revision, being aggrieved by the judgment and order dated 29.04.2016 passed by the learned Special Judge (Atrocities) and Additional Sessions Judge,
Hoshangabad in criminal appeal No.152/2012, by which the appeal filed by the applicant herein was dismissed and the order of the trial Court was confirming, whereby he was made to suffer 1 year rigorous imprisonment under Section 7(1) read with Section 16(1)(A)(i) of Prevention of Food and Adulteration Act.

entities.text: Prevention of Food and Adulteration Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: According to the case against him, the food inspector is said to have inspected the fruit juice shop of the applicant on 12.10.2012 at 2:45 PM and found that he was selling a mix fruit juice in his juice centre.
Upon the sample being taken and tested, the same was found to be substandard, so the case is for conviction against him.
Be that as it may, looking to the facts that short sentence imposed upon the applicant is only one year and revision would take long time to be heard in its usual course and decided on merits.

I deem it appropriate to allow I.A.No.8935/2016 and suspend the remaining part of the sentence and direct that he be enlarged on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.
The applicant is directed to appear before Registry of this Court on 13.08.2015.
